key.name: max-items
key.summary: Maximum number of unpinned history entries
key.description: Pinned entries survive ordinary history cleanup.

key.name: max-item-mb
key.summary: Maximum size of one clipboard entry in MiB
key.description: The limit includes all retained MIME representations.

key.name: max-storage-mb
key.summary: Maximum clipboard payload storage in MiB
key.description: Old unpinned entries are removed first. Pinned entries are never silently removed.

key.name: paused
key.description: Existing entries remain available while recording is paused.
